text.en:
Project No. G-038.27, page 1118-A of Appendix A of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen is amended to read as follows:
"G-038.27(a) Maddella Communal Irrigation GOB-10.00- 10.00-10.00 - - - - - "G-038.27(b) Salat Communal Irrigation, Diffun GOB-5.00- 5.00-5.00 - - - - - "G-0.38.27(c) Aurora East Communal Irrigation, Diffun GOB-5.00- 5.00-5.00 - - - - -"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
